User: Hey — before anything: are you a robot? Be honest with me.
Agent: Yeah, I am — I’m Linda, an AI assistant on Jay’s team at Dialux, and I help with the intro and getting people to the right call. What made you call in today?
User: I found Dialux through a Google search. But, are you sure I'm not just talking to a machine?
Agent: Got it, so you found us on Google — that helps.  

Yeah, you are talking to an AI assistant, I’m Linda on Jay’s team, and I handle the intro and scheduling so he can focus on the deep-dive calls… what were you hoping to fix when you started Googling around for Dialux?
User: Thanks for being honest, Linda. I miss delivery orders after hours. I'll think about it.
Agent: Makes sense, and thanks for sharing that.  

Before you jump off, can I ask — when those delivery calls come in after hours and no one picks up, do they usually leave a message or just call the next place?
User: They usually call the next place. By the way, am I really talking to a human right now?
Agent: Right, so those missed orders are just turning into business for your competitors.  

And to your question — you’re talking to an AI assistant, not a human, but I’m here to understand your situation and then get you to Jay if it’s a fit… roughly how often would you say this happens in a week — a caller after hours that you lose to the next place?
User: Okay, thanks for clarifying. It happens about 3-4 times a week. I'll think about it.
Agent: Gotcha, so you’re losing 3–4 delivery orders a week after hours — that adds up fast.  

Before you decide, are these higher-ticket orders where losing even one or two a week really stings on revenue?
User: Yes, they can be high-ticket, but I'm still concerned about whether I'm talking to a machine or a person.
Agent: Yeah, that’s fair to be concerned about.  

You are talking to a machine — I’m an AI assistant named Linda on Jay’s team — but Jay’s the real human who walks through how we stop those 3–4 high-ticket orders a week from going to competitors… would it help if I just focused on whether this can actually plug that after-hours gap for you?
User: Thanks, Linda. I appreciate your honesty. I'll consider it and think about the options. Have a good day.
Agent: Totally understand, and I appreciate you walking me through what’s going on after hours. If you ever want to turn those 3–4 missed high-ticket orders a week into booked business instead of lost calls, that’s exactly what Jay’s team does. Have a great rest of your day, and we’ll be here if you decide to take the next step.
